description: Use when mapping AI regulatory compliance obligations across multiple states, advising on jurisdiction-specific AI deployment requirements, or briefing legal and compliance teams on the US state AI legislation landscape. As of May 2026, Colorado (June 30), Illinois, Texas, California, Virginia, and 9 additional states have enacted or advanced material AI legislation — creating a patchwork of obligations for multi-state AI deployments without a federal standard. Example: Financial institution deploying AI in 12 states faces 4 distinct compliance regimes with conflicting definitions of high-risk AI — multi-state compliance cost estimated $800K-$2M annually for mid-size institutions. Source: NCSL + Stratalize Regulatory Intelligence. $0.10 USDC per call.

state.description: State name or 2-letter abbreviation. Omit for national summary of all states.
